title: Vowel reduction in conversational Spanish by L1 and L2 speakers
why_promising: Study contributes a genuinely new manually annotated validation subset of 1,043 Spanish vowel productions drawn across 20 talkers. Boundaries were manually assigned and duration plus F1/F2/F3 were recomputed from those manual intervals. This subset is analytically separable in principle from the much larger forced-aligned corpus and therefore could qualify under the database policy even though the underlying Diapix-FL recordings predate the study.
open_question: Need to locate a public deposit containing the identities and manual-boundary-derived measurements for the 1,043-vowel subset. The main 53,444-vowel analysis is forced-aligned and must remain excluded; only the isolated manual subset may be admitted if row-level data and lineage are public.
